name: 股东分红查询
分公司信息
sql_text:
SELECT a.*,b.totalBranchOffice,s.payment_status FROM (
SELECT
	cust_name AS custName,
	cust_phone AS custPhone,
	cust_code AS custCode,
	subject,
	cust_subject_code,
	supplier_cust_name AS supplierCustName,
	city,
	DATE(join_time) AS joinTime,
	score_date AS scoreDate,
	CASE 
	WHEN MONTH(score_date) = 3 THEN
		CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()) -1,'.09.01-',YEAR(CURDATE()), '.02.', CASE 
						WHEN YEAR(CURDATE()) % 4 > 0 THEN '28'
						ELSE '29'
					END)
	WHEN MONTH(score_date) = 6 THEN
	  CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()) -1,'.12.01-',YEAR(CURDATE()),'.05.31')
	WHEN MONTH(score_date) = 9 THEN
	  CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()) ,'.03.01-',YEAR(CURDATE()),'.08.31')
	WHEN MONTH(score_date) = 12 THEN
	  CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()) ,'.06.01-',YEAR(CURDATE()),'.11.30')
	ELSE
		''
END AS dateRange,

	equity_radio,
	pick_up_amount,
	amount,
	FLOOR(equity_score * 0.3) AS equityScore,
	FLOOR(pick_up_score * 0.35) AS pickUpScore,
	FLOOR(recharge_score * 0.35) AS rechargeScore,
	FLOOR(equity_score * 0.3) + FLOOR(pick_up_score * 0.35) + FLOOR(recharge_score * 0.35) AS total_score
	
FROM
	dms_distributor.view_dd_cust_branch_office
WHERE
	cust_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} AND score_date <= #{endTime} ) a
	LEFT JOIN
	(SELECT r.cust_code,COUNT(1) AS totalBranchOffice FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel r
	INNER JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_channel_subject_rel sr ON r.subject_id = sr.subject_id AND sr.sale_mode = 'bcompany' AND sr.sale_channel = 'cloud'
	WHERE r.company_partner_type = 'branch_office' AND sr.sign_status = 'signed'
	 GROUP BY r.cust_code) b ON a.custCode = b.cust_code 
	 LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_cust_payment_standard s ON a.cust_subject_code = s.cust_subject_code AND s.cust_level = 'branch_office'
	 ORDER BY scoreDate DESC

	sum( wms_deliver_count ) AS saleCount,
	ifnull( sum( CASE WHEN founder_company_partner_type IN ( 'founder', 'co_founder', 'personal_founder' ) AND financial_wallet_name = '现金' THEN founder_transaction_price * wms_deliver_count END ), 0 ) AS saleAmount,
	ifnull( sum( CASE WHEN financial_wallet_name = '现金' THEN ( founder_transaction_price - branch_office_transaction_price ) * wms_deliver_count END ), 0 ) AS totalProfit 
FROM
	dms_trading.view_bcompany_deliver_info LEFT JOIN dms_goods.dg_goods_goods g ON goods_code = g.sku_code
	LEFT JOIN centerx.sys_dict_item di ON view_bcompany_deliver_info.founder_company_partner_type = di.`value` 
	AND di.`type` = 'company_partner_type' 
WHERE
	deliver_status IN ( 'SENDED', 'COMPLETED' ) 
	AND deliver_time >= #{startTime}
	AND deliver_time <= #{endTime}
	AND branch_office_customer_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery}
	AND goods_code = #{objQuery.skuQuery}  
	AND wms_deliver_count > 0 
	AND customer_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
GROUP BY
	founder_company_partner_type 
ORDER BY
	saleCount DESC

name: 各类型钱包余额
sql_text:
-- 获取在指定时间范围内每个 id 对应的最后一条记录
WITH last_in_time_range AS (
    SELECT
        a.id,
        b.after_flow_amount,
        b.flow_no,
				a.custom_wallet,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.id ORDER BY b.create_time DESC, b.id DESC) AS rn
    FROM
        (
        SELECT
            id,
            custom_wallet 
        FROM
            dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_bcompany 
        WHERE
            del_flag = 'N' 
            AND custom_wallet IN ( 'ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_SPECIAL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE', 'ACC_NOCASH_RTL', 'ACC_NOCASH_MAT', 'ACC_POSTAGE' ) 
            AND custom_company_partner_type = 'branch_office' 
						AND custom_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
        ) a
    LEFT JOIN dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow b ON a.id = b.custom_wallet_id 
    WHERE
				b.del_flag = 'N'
        AND b.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}  
),
-- 获取在时间范围之前每个 id 对应的最后一条记录
last_before_time_range AS (
    SELECT
        a.id,
        b.after_flow_amount,
        b.flow_no,
				a.custom_wallet,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.id ORDER BY b.create_time DESC, b.id DESC) AS rn
    FROM
        (
        SELECT
            id,
            custom_wallet 
        FROM
            dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_bcompany 
        WHERE
            del_flag = 'N' 
            AND custom_wallet IN ( 'ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_SPECIAL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE', 'ACC_NOCASH_RTL', 'ACC_NOCASH_MAT', 'ACC_POSTAGE' ) 
            AND custom_company_partner_type = 'branch_office'
						AND custom_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery}  
        ) a
    LEFT JOIN dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow b ON a.id = b.custom_wallet_id 
    WHERE
				b.del_flag = 'N'
        AND b.create_time < #{startTime}
)
-- 合并两部分数据，确保每个 id 只有一条记录
SELECT 
	sum(last_after_flow_amount) AS totalAmount,
	CASE
		custom_wallet
			WHEN 'ACC_CASH_BAL' THEN
			'混拿货款'
			WHEN 'ACC_CASH_SPL' THEN
			'小样款'
			WHEN 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE' THEN
			'充邮费(货补)'
			WHEN 'ACC_NOCASH_BAL' THEN
			'采购价赠送款'
			WHEN 'ACC_NOCASH_MBR' THEN
			'会员价赠送款'
			WHEN 'ACC_NOCASH_RTL' THEN
			'零售价赠送款'
			WHEN 'ACC_NOCASH_MAT' THEN
			'物料赠送款'
			WHEN 'ACC_POSTAGE' THEN
			'用邮费(消耗)'
			WHEN 'ACC_MARGIN' THEN
			'保证金'
			WHEN 'ACC_DEPOSIT' THEN
			'押金'
			WHEN 'ACC_INTENTION_MONEY' THEN
			'意向金'
			WHEN 'ACC_SPECIAL' THEN
			'特价款' 
			END AS customWallet,
		count(DISTINCT custom_subject_code) AS countNumber
FROM (
	SELECT
    ids.id,
		ids.custom_wallet,
		ids.wallet_number,
		ids.custom_subject_code,
    COALESCE(last_in_time_range.after_flow_amount, last_before_time_range.after_flow_amount) AS last_after_flow_amount
FROM
    (SELECT 
				id,
				custom_wallet,
				wallet_number,
				custom_subject_code
		 FROM dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_bcompany WHERE 
				del_flag = 'N' 
				AND custom_wallet IN ( 'ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_SPECIAL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE', 'ACC_NOCASH_RTL', 'ACC_NOCASH_MAT', 'ACC_POSTAGE' ) 
				AND custom_company_partner_type = 'branch_office'
				AND custom_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery}  
				AND custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore )
		) ids
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
				id, 
				after_flow_amount, 
				flow_no 
		FROM last_in_time_range WHERE 
				rn = 1
) last_in_time_range ON ids.id = last_in_time_range.id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
				id, 
				after_flow_amount, 
				flow_no 
		FROM last_before_time_range WHERE 
			rn = 1
) last_before_time_range ON ids.id = last_before_time_range.id
ORDER BY ids.id) aa WHERE aa.last_after_flow_amount > 0 GROUP BY custom_wallet

name: 各股东贡献情况
sql_text:
SELECT
        cr.cust_code,
        c.cust_name AS custName,
        IFNULL(a.pickUpAmount,0) AS pickUpAmount,
        IFNULL(a.profit,0) AS profit,
        IFNULL(b.amount,0) AS amount,
        GROUP_CONCAT(cr.company_partner_type) AS company_partner_type,
        GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN cr.company_partner_type = 'founder' THEN
                '总裁'
                WHEN cr.company_partner_type = 'co_founder' THEN
                '总监'
        ELSE
                '小股东'
END
) AS companyPartnerTypeName
FROM
        dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel r
        LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel cr ON r.subject_id = cr.parent_id
        LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer c ON cr.cust_code = c.cust_code
        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
                m.founder_customer_code,
                ifnull( m.pick_up_amount, 0 ) - ifnull( n.refund_amount, 0 ) AS pickUpAmount,
                ifnull( m.deliverProfit, 0 ) - ifnull( amount, 0 ) AS profit 
        FROM
                (
                SELECT
                        founder_customer_code,
                        sum( founder_transaction_price * wms_deliver_count ) AS pick_up_amount,
                        sum(( founder_transaction_price - branch_office_transaction_price ) * wms_deliver_count ) AS deliverProfit 
                FROM
                        dms_trading.view_bcompany_deliver_info 
                WHERE
                        financial_wallet_name = '现金' 
                        AND deliver_status IN ( 'SENDED', 'COMPLETED' ) 
                        AND founder_supplier_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
                        AND deliver_time BETWEEN #{startTime} 
                        AND #{endTime} 
                GROUP BY
                        founder_customer_code 
                ) m
                LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT
                        a.customer_code,
                        sum( a.refund_amount ) AS refund_amount,
                        sum( a.refund_amount - b.refund_amount ) AS amount 
                FROM
                        dms_trading.view_bcompany_aftersale_info a
                        INNER JOIN (
                        SELECT
                                after_sale_main_no,
                                refund_amount 
                        FROM
                                dms_trading.view_bcompany_aftersale_info 
                        WHERE
                                company_partner_type = 'branch_office' 
                                AND after_sale_status = 'COMPLETED' 
                                AND financial_wallet_name = '现金' 
                                AND customer_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
                                AND after_sale_creater_time BETWEEN #{startTime} 
                                AND #{endTime} 
                                AND refund_amount > 0 
                        ) b ON a.after_sale_main_no = b.after_sale_main_no 
                WHERE
                        a.company_partner_type IN ( 'founder', 'co_founder', 'personal_founder' ) 
                GROUP BY
                        a.customer_code 
                ) n ON m.founder_customer_code = n.customer_code 
        ) a ON cr.cust_code = a.founder_customer_code
        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
                amount,
                custom_code 
        FROM
                (
                SELECT
                        SUM( CASE WHEN flow_type = 'out' THEN - flow_amount ELSE flow_amount END ) AS amount,
                        custom_code 
                FROM
                        dms_cwallet.total_amount_view 
                WHERE
                        sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
                        AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} 
                        AND #{endTime} 
                        AND supplier_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
                GROUP BY
                        custom_code 
                ) 
        ) AS b ON cr.cust_code = b.custom_code 
WHERE
        r.cust_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
        AND r.company_partner_type = 'branch_office'
        GROUP BY cr.cust_code ORDER BY amount DESC

sql_text:
WITH last_in_time_range AS (
    SELECT
        a.id,
        b.after_flow_amount,
        b.flow_no,
        a.custom_wallet,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.id ORDER BY b.create_time DESC, b.id DESC) AS rn
    FROM
        dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_bcompany a
    LEFT JOIN dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow b ON a.id = b.custom_wallet_id 
    WHERE
        a.del_flag = 'N' 
        AND a.custom_wallet IN ('ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_SPECIAL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE') 
        AND a.custom_company_partner_type = 'branch_office'
				AND a.custom_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
        AND b.del_flag = 'N'
        AND b.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} 
),
last_before_time_range AS (
    SELECT
        a.id,
        b.after_flow_amount,
        b.flow_no,
        a.custom_wallet,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.id ORDER BY b.create_time DESC, b.id DESC) AS rn
    FROM
        dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_bcompany a
    LEFT JOIN dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow b ON a.id = b.custom_wallet_id 
    WHERE
        a.del_flag = 'N' 
        AND a.custom_wallet IN ('ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_SPECIAL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE') 
        AND a.custom_company_partner_type = 'branch_office' 
				AND a.custom_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
        AND b.del_flag = 'N'
        AND b.create_time < #{startTime}
),
received_payment AS (
	SELECT 
		amount
	FROM
		(SELECT
			SUM( CASE WHEN flow_type = 'out' THEN - flow_amount ELSE flow_amount END ) AS amount,
			custom_subject_code,
			IF(custom_name = supplier_name,custom_name,CONCAT(custom_name,'/',supplier_name)) AS custom_name
		 FROM
			dms_cwallet.total_amount_view 
		 WHERE
			sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
		 AND custom_level = 'branch_office' 
		 AND custom_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
		 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} 
		 ) 
),
delivered_goods AS (
	SELECT
		ifnull( m.pick_up_amount, 0 ) - ifnull( n.refund_amount, 0 ) AS pickUpAmount 
	FROM
		(
		SELECT
			sum( founder_transaction_price * wms_deliver_count ) AS pick_up_amount 
		FROM
			dms_trading.view_bcompany_deliver_info 
		WHERE
			financial_wallet_name = '现金' 
			AND deliver_status IN ( 'SENDED', 'COMPLETED' ) 
			AND founder_supplier_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
			AND deliver_time >= #{startTime}  
			AND deliver_time <= #{endTime}
			
		) m
		CROSS JOIN (
		SELECT
			sum( refund_amount ) AS refund_amount 
		FROM
			dms_trading.view_bcompany_aftersale_info 
		WHERE
			company_partner_type = 'branch_office' 
			AND after_sale_status = 'COMPLETED' 
			AND financial_wallet_name = '现金' 
			AND customer_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
			AND after_sale_creater_time >= #{startTime} 
			AND after_sale_creater_time <= #{endTime}
		) n
),
merged_data AS (
    SELECT
        ids.id,
        ids.custom_wallet,
        ids.wallet_number,
				ids.custom_code,
        dcm.custom_name,
        COALESCE(last_in_time_range.after_flow_amount, last_before_time_range.after_flow_amount) AS last_after_flow_amount
    FROM
        dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_bcompany ids
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            id, 
            after_flow_amount, 
            flow_no 
        FROM last_in_time_range 
        WHERE rn = 1
    ) last_in_time_range ON ids.id = last_in_time_range.id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            id, 
            after_flow_amount, 
            flow_no 
        FROM last_before_time_range 
        WHERE rn = 1
    ) last_before_time_range ON ids.id = last_before_time_range.id
		LEFT JOIN 
			dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_meta dcm 
			ON ids.custom_code = dcm.dc_custom_id
    WHERE 
        ids.del_flag = 'N' 
        AND ids.custom_wallet IN ('ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_SPECIAL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE') 
        AND ids.custom_company_partner_type = 'branch_office'
				AND ids.custom_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
				GROUP BY ids.id
)
SELECT
	SUM( a.last_after_flow_amount ) AS receivedPayment,
	b.amount AS totalAmount,
	c.pickUpAmount AS deliveredGoods
FROM
	merged_data a,
	received_payment b,
	delivered_goods c

SELECT
	CASE

			'总监' 
			WHEN m.founder_company_partner_type = 'founder' THEN

			WHEN m.founder_company_partner_type = 'personal_founder' THEN
			'小股东' 
		END AS companyPartnerType,
	ifnull( m.deliverProfit, 0 ) - ifnull( n.amount, 0 ) as profit
FROM

		AND deliver_time >= #{startTime}
		AND deliver_time <= #{endTime}
	GROUP BY
		founder_company_partner_type 
	HAVING
		deliverProfit > 0 
	) m

		sum( a.refund_amount - b.refund_amount ) AS amount

		) b ON a.after_sale_main_no = b.after_sale_main_no 
	WHERE
		a.company_partner_type IN ( 'founder', 'co_founder', 'personal_founder' ) 
	GROUP BY
		a.company_partner_type 
	HAVING
	amount > 0 
	) n ON m.founder_company_partner_type = n.company_partner_type

name: 核心指标

SELECT
	* 
FROM
	(
	SELECT
		COUNT(
		IF
		( cr.company_partner_type = 'co_founder' AND sr.join_time >= #{startTime} AND sr.join_time <= #{endTime}, 1, NULL )) AS coFounder,
		COUNT(
		IF
		( cr.company_partner_type = 'personal_founder' AND sr.join_time >= #{startTime} AND sr.join_time <= #{endTime}, 1, NULL )) AS personalFounder,
	IFNULL(IF
		(
			100 - SUM( cr.equity_radio ) < 0,
			0,
		100 - SUM( cr.equity_radio )), 0) AS lastRadio 
	FROM
		dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel r
		LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel cr ON r.subject_id = cr.parent_id 
		AND cr.company_partner_type != 'founder'
		LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_channel_subject_rel sr ON cr.subject_id = sr.subject_id 
		AND sr.sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
		AND sr.sale_channel = 'cloud' 
	WHERE
		r.cust_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
		AND r.company_partner_type = 'branch_office' 
	) a,
	(
	SELECT
		SUM(
		IF
		( flow_type = 'out', 0-flow_amount, flow_amount )) AS totalAmount 
	FROM
		dms_cwallet.total_amount_view 
	WHERE
		sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
		AND supplier_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
		AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime}  AND #{endTime}
		AND custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
	) b,
	(
		SELECT target_amount AS targetAmount FROM dms_cwallet.dcw_data_board_payment_target_branch_office WHERE custom_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery}
	)c,
	(
	SELECT
		SUM(
		IF
		( flow_type = 'out', 0-flow_amount, flow_amount )) AS totalAmountBranchOffice 
	FROM
		dms_cwallet.total_amount_view 
	WHERE
		sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
		AND custom_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
		AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime}  AND #{endTime}
		AND custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
	) e,
	(
		SELECT count(1) recommendBranchOffice
		 FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel r 
		INNER JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_channel_subject_rel sr ON r.subject_id = sr.subject_id

-- 窗口函数 单独为地址排个序
WITH addrTemp AS (
	SELECT
		ca.cust_code,
		CONCAT( ca.province, ca.city, ca.region, ca.addr ) AS addr,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.cust_code ORDER BY ca.create_time DESC ) AS rn 
	FROM
		dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel r
		LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel cr ON r.subject_id = cr.parent_id
		LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_addr ca ON cr.cust_code = ca.cust_code 
		AND ca.type = 'cust' 
	WHERE
		r.cust_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery}
		
		AND cr.company_partner_type IN (
			'co_founder',
			'personal_founder' 
		)
)
SELECT
	c.cust_code,
	c.cust_name,
	c.cust_phone,
	CASE
	WHEN cr.company_partner_type = 'head_office' THEN
		'总公司'
		WHEN cr.company_partner_type = 'branch_office' THEN
		'分公司'
		WHEN cr.company_partner_type = 'founder' THEN
		'总裁'
		WHEN cr.company_partner_type = 'co_founder' THEN
		'总监'
		WHEN cr.company_partner_type = 'personal_founder' THEN
		'小股东'
	ELSE
		""
END AS company_partner_type,
	DATE_FORMAT(sr.join_time,'%y-%m-%d') AS join_time,
	ci.sex,
	ci.age,
	temp.addr,
	a.maxPaymentTime,
	a.daysSinceLastOrder,-- 未下单天数
	b.pickUpAmount,
	c.contributeProfit, -- 贡献利润
  d.amount AS totalAmount, -- 今年累计回款	
	e.balance -- 混拿余额
	
FROM
	dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel r
	LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel cr ON r.subject_id = cr.parent_id
	LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_channel_subject_rel sr ON cr.subject_id = sr.subject_id 
	AND sr.sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
	AND sr.sale_channel = 'cloud'
	LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer c ON cr.cust_code = c.cust_code
	LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.view_dd_cust_customer_info ci ON cr.cust_code = ci.cust_code 
	-- 地址
	LEFT JOIN addrTemp temp ON cr.cust_code = temp.cust_code AND temp.rn = 1
	-- 多少天未下单
	LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT
		customer_subject_code AS customerSubjectCode,
		DATE_FORMAT( MAX( payment_time ), '%y.%m.%d' ) AS maxPaymentTime,
		CONCAT( '(', FLOOR( DATEDIFF( CURRENT_DATE, MAX( payment_time ))), ' 天未下单)' ) AS daysSinceLastOrder 
	FROM
		dms_trading.dt_order 
	WHERE
		order_status IN ( 'PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING', 'COMPLETED' ) 
		AND transfer_flag = 'Y' 
		AND supplier_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
	GROUP BY
		customer_subject_code 
	) a ON cr.cust_subject_code = a.customerSubjectCode
	LEFT JOIN (-- 累计已提货金额
	SELECT
		a.customer_subject_code AS customerSubjectCode,
		TRUNCATE (( a.amount - ifnull( b.afterSaleAmount, 0 )), 2 ) AS pickUpAmount 
	FROM
		(
			(
			SELECT
				customer_subject_code,
				ifnull( sum( CASE WHEN o.financial_wallet_name = '现金' THEN ( o.goods_count - o.cancelled_count ) * transaction_price END ), 0 ) AS amount 
			FROM
				dms_trading.view_bcompany_order_info o 
			WHERE
				transfer_flag = 'Y' 
				AND o.order_status IN ( 'PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING', 'COMPLETED' ) 
				AND o.warehouse_code = 'SH01' 
				AND supplier_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
				AND o.payment_time >= DATE_FORMAT( CURDATE(), '%Y-01-01' ) 
				AND o.customer_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
			GROUP BY
				o.customer_subject_code 
			) a
			LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT
				customer_subject_code,
				ifnull( sum( CASE WHEN financial_wallet_name = '现金' THEN refund_amount END ), 0 ) AS afterSaleAmount 
			FROM
				dms_trading.view_bcompany_aftersale_info 
			WHERE
				after_sale_status = 'COMPLETED' 
				AND order_transfer_flag = 'Y' 
				AND supplier_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
				AND warehouse_checker_time >= DATE_FORMAT( CURDATE(), '%Y-01-01' ) 
			GROUP BY
				customer_subject_code 
			) b ON a.customer_subject_code = b.customer_subject_code 
		) 
	) b ON b.customerSubjectCode = cr.cust_subject_code
	
	LEFT JOIN (-- 贡献利润
	SELECT
		a.customer_subject_code AS customerSubjectCode,
		TRUNCATE (( a.amount - ifnull( c.afterSaleAmount, 0 )), 2 ) AS contributeProfit 
	FROM
		(
			(
			SELECT
				m.customer_subject_code,
				m.firstOrderAmount + m.amount AS amount 
			FROM
				(
				SELECT
					o.customer_subject_code,
				CASE
						
						WHEN o.order_type = 'FIRST_ORDER' THEN
						350.04 ELSE 0 
					END AS firstOrderAmount,
					ifnull(
						sum(
						CASE
								
								WHEN o.financial_wallet_name = '现金' 
								AND o.order_type = 'NORMAL_ORDER' THEN
									( o.goods_count - o.cancelled_count ) * ( o.transaction_price - o1.transaction_price ) ELSE 0 
								END 
								),
								0 
							) AS amount 
						FROM
							dms_trading.view_bcompany_order_info o
							INNER JOIN dms_trading.view_bcompany_order_info o1 ON o.transfer_main_no = o1.transfer_main_no 
							AND o.supplier_subject_code = o1.customer_subject_code 
							AND o1.company_partner_type = 'branch_office' 
							AND o.stock_goods_unique_no = o1.stock_goods_unique_no 
						WHERE
							o.transfer_flag = 'Y' 
							AND o.order_status IN ( 'PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING', 'COMPLETED' ) 
							AND o.warehouse_code = 'SH01' 
							AND o.supplier_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
							AND o.payment_time >= DATE_FORMAT( CURDATE(), '%Y-01-01' ) 
							AND o.customer_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
						GROUP BY
							o.customer_subject_code 
						) m 
					) a
					LEFT JOIN (
					SELECT
						customer_subject_code,
						ifnull( sum( CASE WHEN financial_wallet_name = '现金' THEN refund_amount END ), 0 ) AS afterSaleAmount 
					FROM
						dms_trading.view_bcompany_aftersale_info 
					WHERE
						after_sale_status = 'COMPLETED' 
						AND order_transfer_flag = 'Y' 
						AND supplier_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
						AND warehouse_checker_time >= DATE_FORMAT( CURDATE(), '%Y-01-01' ) 
					GROUP BY
						customer_subject_code 
					) c ON a.customer_subject_code = c.customer_subject_code 
				) 
			) c ON c.customerSubjectCode = cr.cust_subject_code
			-- 累计回款
			LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT
				amount,
				subject_code 
			FROM
				(
				SELECT
					SUM( CASE WHEN flow_type = 'out' THEN - flow_amount ELSE flow_amount END ) AS amount,
					custom_subject_code AS subject_code 
				FROM
					dms_cwallet.total_amount_view 
				WHERE
					sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
					AND custom_wallet IN ('ACC_CASH_BAL','ACC_CASH_POSTAGE','ACC_SPECIAL') 
					AND custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
					AND create_time >= CONCAT( YEAR ( CURDATE()), '-01-01 00:00:00' ) 
					AND custom_subject_code IN (
					SELECT
						cr.cust_subject_code 
					FROM
						dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel r
						LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel cr ON r.subject_id = cr.parent_id 
					WHERE
						r.cust_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
						AND cr.company_partner_type IN ( 'co_founder', 'personal_founder' ) 
					) 
				GROUP BY
					custom_subject_code 
				) 
			) d ON d.subject_code = cr.cust_subject_code
			-- 混拿余额
			LEFT JOIN (
					SELECT
									SUM( balance - lock_balance ) AS balance,
									custom_subject_code
					FROM
									dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_bcompany 
					WHERE
									custom_wallet = 'ACC_CASH_BAL' 
									AND custom_subject_code IN ( SELECT
						cr.cust_subject_code 
					FROM
						dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel r
						LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel cr ON r.subject_id = cr.parent_id 
					WHERE
						r.cust_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
						AND cr.company_partner_type IN ( 'co_founder', 'personal_founder' )  ) 
					GROUP BY
									custom_subject_code
			) e ON e.custom_subject_code = cr.cust_subject_code
			
		WHERE
			r.cust_subject_code = #{objQuery.custQuery} 
		AND cr.company_partner_type IN ( 'co_founder', 'personal_founder' ) 
	AND sr.sign_status = 'signed'
	ORDER BY e.balance DESC

-- 获取在指定时间范围内每个 id 对应的最后一条记录
WITH last_in_time_range AS (
    SELECT
        a.id,
        b.after_flow_amount,
        b.flow_no,
				a.custom_wallet,
				a.custom_subject_code,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.id ORDER BY b.create_time DESC, b.id DESC) AS rn
    FROM
        (
        SELECT
            id,
            custom_wallet,
						custom_subject_code 
        FROM
            dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_bcompany 
        WHERE
            del_flag = 'N' 
            AND custom_wallet = 'ACC_CASH_BAL'
            AND custom_company_partner_type = #{companyPartnerType}  
        ) a
    LEFT JOIN dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow b ON a.id = b.custom_wallet_id 
    WHERE
				b.del_flag = 'N'
        AND b.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}   
),
-- 获取在时间范围之前每个 id 对应的最后一条记录
last_before_time_range AS (
    SELECT
        a.id,
        b.after_flow_amount,
        b.flow_no,
				a.custom_wallet,
				a.custom_subject_code,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.id ORDER BY b.create_time DESC, b.id DESC) AS rn
    FROM
        (
        SELECT
            id,
            custom_wallet,
						custom_subject_code 
        FROM
            dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_bcompany 
        WHERE
            del_flag = 'N' 
            AND custom_wallet = 'ACC_CASH_BAL'
            AND custom_company_partner_type = #{companyPartnerType} 
        ) a
    LEFT JOIN dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow b ON a.id = b.custom_wallet_id 
    WHERE
				b.del_flag = 'N'
        AND b.create_time < #{startTime}
),
custom_info_by_distributor AS (
	SELECT
	cc.cust_name,
	cs.subject,
	cs.credit_card
FROM
	dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel r
	INNER JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_channel_subject_rel sr ON r.subject_id = sr.subject_id
	INNER JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject cs ON r.cust_subject_code = cs.credit_card
	INNER JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer cc ON r.cust_code = cc.cust_code
	AND sr.sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
	AND sr.sale_channel = 'cloud' 
WHERE
	r.company_partner_type = #{companyPartnerType} 
	AND sr.sign_status = 'signed'
	AND r.cust_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore)
),
custom_total_amount AS (
	SELECT 
	amount,
	subject_code
FROM
	(SELECT
		SUM( CASE WHEN flow_type = 'out' THEN - flow_amount ELSE flow_amount END ) AS amount,
		custom_subject_code AS subject_code
	 FROM
		dms_cwallet.total_amount_view 
	 WHERE
		sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
	 AND custom_level = #{companyPartnerType} 
	 AND custom_wallet = 'ACC_CASH_BAL'
	 AND custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
	 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}  
   GROUP BY custom_subject_code)
),
extract_amount_info AS (
	SELECT
        a.customer_subject_code as custom_subject_code,
        TRUNCATE((a.amount - ifnull(b.afterSaleAmount,0)),2)  as extract_amount
FROM
        (
                (
                SELECT
                        customer_subject_code,
                        ifnull(sum(case when o.customer_wallet_code = 'ACC_CASH_BAL'  then (o.goods_count - o.cancelled_count) * transaction_price end ) ,0 ) as amount 
                FROM
                        dms_trading.view_bcompany_order_info o
                        INNER JOIN dms_goods.dg_goods_goods goods ON o.goods_code = goods.sku_code 
                WHERE
                        o.company_partner_type = #{companyPartnerType} 
                        AND o.order_status IN ( 'PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING','COMPLETED') 
                        AND o.warehouse_code = 'SH01' 
												AND o.payment_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}  
                        AND o.customer_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
                GROUP BY
                        o.customer_subject_code 
                ) a left join 
        ( SELECT
                customer_subject_code,
                ifnull(sum(CASE WHEN customer_wallet_code = 'ACC_CASH_BAL' then refund_amount end ),0) as afterSaleAmount
                FROM
                        dms_trading.view_bcompany_aftersale_info 
                WHERE
                        after_sale_status = 'COMPLETED' 
                        AND company_partner_type = #{companyPartnerType} 
												AND warehouse_checker_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}  
                GROUP BY
                        customer_subject_code 
                ) b on a.customer_subject_code = b.customer_subject_code
        ) where amount > 0
),
total_first_order_info AS (
	 SELECT
                o.customer_subject_code as  custom_subject_code,
                COUNT( DISTINCT o.order_no ) AS total_first_order 
        FROM
                dms_trading.dt_order o 
        WHERE
                o.del_flag = 'N' 
                AND o.sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
                AND o.sale_channel = 'cloud' 
                AND o.company_partner_type = #{companyPartnerType} 
                AND o.order_type = 'FIRST_ORDER' 
                AND o.warehouse_code = 'SH01' 
                AND o.payment_status != 'UNPAID' 
                AND o.order_status IN ( 'PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING', 'COMPLETED' )
								AND payment_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}   
                AND o.customer_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
                GROUP BY o.customer_subject_code 
)
-- 合并两部分数据，确保每个 id 只有一条记录
SELECT 
	s1.cust_name,
	IF(remainingBalance IS NULL,0,remainingBalance) remainingBalance,
	s2.custom_subject_code,
	IF(total_amount IS NULL,0,total_amount) total_amount,
	IF(extract_amount IS NULL,0,extract_amount) extract_amount,
	IF(total_first_order IS NULL,0,total_first_order) total_first_order,
	s6.branch_name
FROM
	(
		SELECT cust_name,credit_card FROM custom_info_by_distributor
	) s1 LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT 
		sum(last_after_flow_amount) AS remainingBalance,
		custom_subject_code
	FROM (
		SELECT
			ids.id,
			ids.custom_wallet,
			ids.wallet_number,
			ids.custom_subject_code,
			COALESCE(last_in_time_range.after_flow_amount, last_before_time_range.after_flow_amount) AS last_after_flow_amount
	FROM
			(SELECT 
					id,
					custom_wallet,
					wallet_number,
					custom_subject_code
			 FROM dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_bcompany WHERE 
					del_flag = 'N' 
					AND custom_wallet = 'ACC_CASH_BAL'
					AND custom_company_partner_type = #{companyPartnerType} 
					AND custom_code NOT IN (SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore)
			) ids
	LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT 
					id, 
					after_flow_amount, 
					flow_no,
					custom_subject_code 
			FROM last_in_time_range WHERE 
					rn = 1
	) last_in_time_range ON ids.id = last_in_time_range.id
	LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT 
					id, 
					after_flow_amount, 
					flow_no,
					custom_subject_code 
			FROM last_before_time_range WHERE
				rn = 1
	) last_before_time_range ON ids.id = last_before_time_range.id
	ORDER BY ids.id) aa GROUP BY custom_subject_code
) s2 ON s1.credit_card = s2.custom_subject_code 
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT amount AS total_amount,subject_code FROM custom_total_amount
	) s3 ON s1.credit_card = s3.subject_code
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT custom_subject_code,extract_amount FROM extract_amount_info
	) s4 ON s1.credit_card = s4.custom_subject_code
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT total_first_order,custom_subject_code FROM total_first_order_info
	) s5 ON s1.credit_card = s5.custom_subject_code
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT
		sr.cust_subject_code,
		pc.cust_name AS branch_name,
		ppc.cust_name AS head_name 
	FROM

name: 发货单数据

SELECT
		count( 1 ) AS deliverCount,
		SUM( CASE WHEN full_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS deliverFullCount,
		SUM( CASE WHEN full_flag = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS deliverUnfullCount ,
		sum(case when deliver_status in('SENDED','COMPLETED') then 1 else 0 end ) sendedCount,
		sum(case when deliver_status in('PENDING_SEND','SENDING') then 1 else 0 end ) pendingSendCount,
		TRUNCATE((sum(case when deliver_status in('SENDED','COMPLETED') then 1 else 0 end ) / (dateDiff(DATE(#{endTime}), DATE(#{startTime})) + 1) ),2) as dayAverageDeliver
	FROM
		dms_trading.dt_deliver 
	WHERE
		del_flag = 'N' 
		AND sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
		AND warehouse_code = 'SH01' 
		AND push_wms_flag = 'Y' 
		AND deliver_status !=  'CANCELLED'
		AND generate_time >= #{startTime} 
	AND generate_time <= #{endTime} 
	and customer_code not in (SELECT cust_code from dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore )

                WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, a.create_time, a.deliver_time) <= 24 THEN '24H以内'
                WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, a.create_time, a.deliver_time) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '1-3天'
                WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, a.create_time, a.deliver_time) BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN '4-7天'
                WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, a.create_time, a.deliver_time) BETWEEN 8 AND 15 THEN '8-15天'
                ELSE '15天以后'
            END AS delivery_time_category
        FROM 
            dms_trading.dt_deliver a 
        WHERE 
            a.deliver_status = 'COMPLETED' 
            AND a.sale_mode = 'bcompany'
						AND a.warehouse_code = 'SH01'
						AND a.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
    ) AS temp
GROUP BY 
    delivery_time_category
ORDER BY 
    FIELD(delivery_time_category, '24H以内', '1-3天', '4-7天', '8-15天', '15天以后')
remarks: 指时间范围内系统推送给仓库的发货单中，从推送到仓库完成发货所使用的时间；

name: 商品数据-商品销售目标
sql_text:
SELECT
	*,
	saleTarget - totalAmount AS difference,
	ROUND( totalAmount / saleTarget * 100, 2 ) AS rate 
FROM
	(
	SELECT
		IFNULL( g.sku_short_name, g.sku_name ) AS skuName,
		CAST(
		10000 / 365 * ( DATEDIFF( DATE ( #{endTime} ), DATE ( #{startTime} )) + 1 ) * 10000 AS DECIMAL ( 12, 2 )) AS saleTarget,
		o.totalAmount 
	FROM
		dms_goods.dg_goods_goods g
		LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT
			a.goods_code,
			ifnull( a.totalAmount, 0 ) - IFNULL( t.afterSaleAmount, 0 ) AS totalAmount 
		FROM
			(
				(
				SELECT
					goods_code,
					ifnull( sum( wms_deliver_count * branch_office_transaction_price ), 0 ) `totalAmount` 
				FROM
					dms_trading.view_bcompany_deliver_info 
				WHERE
					deliver_status IN ( 'SENDED', 'COMPLETED' ) 
					AND deliver_time BETWEEN #{startTime} 
					AND #{endTime} AND financial_wallet_name = '现金' AND customer_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) GROUP BY goods_code HAVING `totalAmount` > 0 
				) a
				LEFT JOIN (
				SELECT
					goods_code,
					ifnull( sum( refund_amount ), 0 ) AS afterSaleAmount 
				FROM
					dms_trading.view_bcompany_aftersale_info 
				WHERE
					after_sale_status = 'COMPLETED' 
					AND company_partner_type = 'branch_office' 
					AND customer_wallet_code IN ( 'ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_SPECIAL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE' ) 
					AND after_sale_creater_time BETWEEN #{startTime} 
					AND #{endTime} AND financial_wallet_name = '现金' AND customer_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) GROUP BY goods_code HAVING afterSaleAmount > 0 
				) t ON a.goods_code = t.goods_code 
			)) AS o ON g.sku_code = o.goods_code 
	WHERE
		g.sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
		AND g.sku_flag = 'S' 
		AND g.category_code NOT IN (
		SELECT
			sub_catg_code 
		FROM
			dms_goods.dg_goods_category_rel 
		WHERE
		catg_code IN ( 'FL1006', 'FL1005' )) 
	ORDER BY
	o.totalAmount DESC 
	LIMIT 10)
remarks: 指时间范围内该商品的目标（由业务提供）及已发货的商品金额及差额；

name: 商品数据-库销比
sql_text:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH rank_stock AS (
	SELECT
		g.sku_code,
		IFNULL( g.sku_short_name, g.sku_name ) AS skuName,
		IFNULL(d.ch_quantity,0) AS ch_quantity,
		IFNULL(d.changed_quantity, 0) AS changed_quantity,
		IFNULL(d.before_quantity, 0) AS before_quantity,
		d.reason,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY d.sku_code ORDER BY d.create_time ) AS rn 
	FROM
		dms_goods.dg_goods_goods g
		INNER JOIN dms_goods.dg_goods_wh_ch_detail d ON d.sku_code = g.sku_code 
		
	WHERE
		g.sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
		AND d.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
		AND g.sku_flag = 'S' 
		AND g.category_code NOT IN (SELECT sub_catg_code FROM dms_goods.dg_goods_category_rel WHERE catg_code IN ('FL1006','FL1005')) 
	),
	before_stock AS (
	SELECT * FROM rank_stock WHERE rn = 1
	)
	
	SELECT
	rs.sku_code,
	rs.skuName,
	IFNULL( bs.before_quantity, 0 ) + SUM(IF(rs.reason LIKE 'in%',IFNULL( rs.ch_quantity, 0),0)) AS stock,
	IFNULL( o.saleCount, 0 ) AS saleCount,
	IFNULL( ROUND( (IFNULL( bs.before_quantity, 0 ) + SUM(IF(rs.reason LIKE 'in%',IFNULL( rs.ch_quantity, 0),0)))/ o.saleCount, 2 ), 0 ) AS rate 
FROM
before_stock bs 
LEFT JOIN
	rank_stock rs ON bs.sku_code = rs.sku_code
	LEFT JOIN (-- 查询销量数据
	SELECT
		od.goods_code,
		sum( od.goods_count - od.cancelled_count ) AS saleCount 
	FROM
		dms_trading.dt_order AS o
		INNER JOIN dms_trading.dt_order_detail AS od ON o.order_no = od.order_no 
	WHERE
		( o.del_flag = 'N' ) 
		AND ( o.sale_mode = 'bcompany' ) 
		AND ( o.warehouse_code = 'SH01' ) 
		AND ( o.transfer_flag = 'Y' ) 
		AND ( o.order_type != 'SUBSTITUTE_DELIVERY_ORDER' ) 
		AND ( o.payment_status != 'UNPAID' ) 
		AND (
		o.order_status IN ( 'PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING', 'COMPLETED' )) 
		AND o.order_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
	GROUP BY
		od.goods_code 
	) AS o ON rs.sku_code = o.goods_code 
	GROUP BY bs.sku_code
 ) ORDER BY rate DESC
remarks: 截止到时间范围内的结束时间系统内的库存数量除以时间范围内该商品的销售数量；

name: 区域回款占比
sql_text:
SELECT 
	aa.region AS region, -- 区域
	aa.totalAmount AS regionAmount, -- 区域回款额
	aa.targetAmount AS targetAmount, -- 区域目标额
	(aa.totalAmount/bb.sumTotalAmount)*100 AS collectionRatio, -- 回款占比
	IF(aa.targetAmount - aa.totalAmount < 0,0,aa.targetAmount - aa.totalAmount) AS difference, -- 区域回款目标差
	IF(((aa.targetAmount - aa.totalAmount)/aa.targetAmount)*100 < 0 ,0,((aa.targetAmount - aa.totalAmount)/aa.targetAmount)*100) AS extremeRatio -- 额极占比
FROM 
	(SELECT 
		a.region,
		a.totalAmount,
		IF(b.targetAmount IS NULL, 0, b.targetAmount) AS targetAmount
	 FROM
		(SELECT SUM(IF(flow_type = 'out',0-flow_amount,flow_amount)) AS totalAmount,region FROM dms_cwallet.total_amount_view
			WHERE sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
			AND custom_level = 'branch_office'  
			and project_category not in ('old_and_new_cash_balance_merge','old_and_new_no_cash_balance_merge','custom_transform','strategy_transform','strategy_transform_change','org_transfer_a_a','history_after_sales_transfer','dms_initial_data','brand_merger_single_to_full','three_in_one_transfer','whole_brand_transfer')
			AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} 
			AND custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore)
			GROUP BY region
		) a 
			LEFT JOIN

			WHERE sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
			AND to_date BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} 
			AND custom_code NOT IN (SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore) 
			GROUP BY region
		) b 
	ON a.region = b.region
	) aa,
	(SELECT	SUM(IF(flow_type = 'out',0-flow_amount,flow_amount)) AS sumTotalAmount FROM dms_cwallet.total_amount_view 
		WHERE sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
		AND custom_level = 'branch_office'

		AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} 
		AND custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore)

name: 各类型钱包余额
sql_text:
-- 获取在指定时间范围内每个 id 对应的最后一条记录
WITH last_in_time_range AS (
    SELECT
        a.id,
        b.after_flow_amount,
        b.flow_no,
				a.custom_wallet,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.id ORDER BY b.create_time DESC, b.id DESC) AS rn
    FROM
        (
        SELECT
            id,
            custom_wallet 
        FROM
            dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_bcompany 
        WHERE
            del_flag = 'N' 
            AND custom_wallet IN ( 'ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_SPECIAL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE', 'ACC_NOCASH_RTL', 'ACC_NOCASH_MAT', 'ACC_POSTAGE' ) 
            AND custom_company_partner_type = 'branch_office' 
        ) a
    LEFT JOIN dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow b ON a.id = b.custom_wallet_id 
    WHERE
				b.del_flag = 'N'
        AND b.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}  
),
-- 获取在时间范围之前每个 id 对应的最后一条记录
last_before_time_range AS (
    SELECT
        a.id,
        b.after_flow_amount,
        b.flow_no,
				a.custom_wallet,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.id ORDER BY b.create_time DESC, b.id DESC) AS rn
    FROM
        (
        SELECT
            id,
            custom_wallet 
        FROM
            dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_bcompany 
        WHERE
            del_flag = 'N' 
            AND custom_wallet IN ( 'ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_SPECIAL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE', 'ACC_NOCASH_RTL', 'ACC_NOCASH_MAT', 'ACC_POSTAGE' ) 
            AND custom_company_partner_type = 'branch_office' 
        ) a
    LEFT JOIN dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow b ON a.id = b.custom_wallet_id 
    WHERE
				b.del_flag = 'N'
        AND b.create_time < #{startTime}
)
-- 合并两部分数据，确保每个 id 只有一条记录
SELECT 
	sum(last_after_flow_amount) AS totalAmount,
	CASE
		custom_wallet
			WHEN 'ACC_CASH_BAL' THEN
			'混拿货款'
			WHEN 'ACC_CASH_SPL' THEN
			'小样款'
			WHEN 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE' THEN
			'充邮费(货补)'
			WHEN 'ACC_NOCASH_BAL' THEN
			'采购价赠送款'
			WHEN 'ACC_NOCASH_MBR' THEN
			'会员价赠送款'
			WHEN 'ACC_NOCASH_RTL' THEN
			'零售价赠送款'

		ids.wallet_number,
		ids.custom_subject_code,
    COALESCE(last_in_time_range.after_flow_amount, last_before_time_range.after_flow_amount) AS last_after_flow_amount

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT

				flow_no 
		FROM last_in_time_range WHERE

) last_in_time_range ON ids.id = last_in_time_range.id
LEFT JOIN (

				flow_no 
		FROM last_before_time_range WHERE

name: 参与活动客户占比数据
sql_text:
SELECT
    case custom_account_count
		WHEN 0 THEN '未参加过'
		WHEN 1 THEN '参与1次'
		WHEN 2 THEN '参与2次'
		WHEN 3 THEN '参与3次'
		WHEN 4 THEN '大于3次'
		ELSE '未知'
		END as 'custom_account_count',
    SUM(CASE WHEN custom_bcompany_type = '分公司' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS branch_office_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN custom_bcompany_type = '总监小股东' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS co_founder_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        AA.cust_code,
        AA.cust_subject_code,
        AA.custom_bcompany_type,
        CASE 
            WHEN IF(AA.custom_account_type = '未参加', 0, COUNT(AA.custom_account_type)) = 0 THEN 0
            WHEN IF(AA.custom_account_type = '未参加', 0, COUNT(AA.custom_account_type)) = 1 THEN 1
            WHEN IF(AA.custom_account_type = '未参加', 0, COUNT(AA.custom_account_type)) = 2 THEN 2
            WHEN IF(AA.custom_account_type = '未参加', 0, COUNT(AA.custom_account_type)) = 3 THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END AS custom_account_count
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            dr.cust_code,
            dr.cust_subject_code,
            CASE
                dr.company_partner_type 
                WHEN 'branch_office' THEN '分公司' 
                WHEN 'co_founder' THEN '总监小股东' 
                WHEN 'personal_founder' THEN '总监小股东' 
                ELSE '未知' 
            END AS custom_bcompany_type,
            IFNULL(A.custom_account_type, '未参加') AS custom_account_type,
            IFNULL(A.custom_account_type_name, '未参加') AS custom_account_type_name
        FROM
            dms_distributor.dd_cust_channel_subject_rel dcr 
        JOIN 
            dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel dr 
        ON 
            dcr.subject_id = dr.subject_id 
            AND dcr.sign_status = 'signed' 
            AND dr.company_partner_type IN ('branch_office', 'co_founder', 'personal_founder') 
            AND dcr.sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
            AND dr.cust_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
            AND dcr.join_time >= #{startTime} 
            AND dcr.join_time <= #{endTime}
-- 						AND dcr.join_time >= '2024-03-01 00:00:00'
-- 						AND dcr.join_time < '2024-08-06 15:38:00'
        LEFT JOIN 
        (
            SELECT
                a.custom_subject_code,
                b.custom_account_type,
                b.custom_account_type_name,
                SUM(
                    IF(a.flow_type = 'out', 0 - a.flow_amount, a.flow_amount)
                ) AS amount 
            FROM
                dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow a
            JOIN 
                dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow_related b 
            ON 
                a.flow_no = b.flow_no 
            WHERE
                a.del_flag = 'N' 
                AND b.del_flag = 'N' 
                AND a.business_flow = 'Y' 
                AND a.project_category IN ('strategy_recharge', 'pre_charge', 'strategy_transform', 'custom_transform', 'brand_merger_single_to_full', 'client_up_bill', 'client_down_bill', 'apply_for_posting', 'apply_for_posting_down', 'exit') 
                AND b.custom_wallet = 'ACC_CASH_BAL' 
                AND a.sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
                AND b.custom_account_type IS NOT NULL 
                AND b.custom_account_type != 'normal_wallet' 
                AND b.custom_bcompany_type IN ('branch_office', 'co_founder', 'personal_founder') 
            GROUP BY
                a.custom_subject_code,
                b.custom_account_type 
        ) A 
        ON dr.cust_subject_code = A.custom_subject_code    
        WHERE 
            dr.company_partner_type IN ('branch_office', 'co_founder', 'personal_founder')  AND (amount > 0 or amount is null)
    ) AA 
    GROUP BY
        AA.cust_subject_code
) grouped_data

GROUP BY
    custom_account_count
ORDER BY
    FIELD(custom_account_count,'未参加过','参与1次','参与2次','参与3次','大于3次')
remarks: 指时间范围内注册的客户中，参与公司充值活动的客户数量以及占比；

sql_text:
SELECT 
	targetAmount,-- 目标回款额度
	totalAmount,-- 累计回款额
	ROUND(completionRate,2) AS completionRate,-- 达成率
	difference,-- 差额
	difference/remainingDays AS dailyCompletion,-- 每日需完成
	totalAmount + ((totalAmount/passedDays)*remainingDays) AS expectedCompletion, -- 预计完成
	headOfficeAmount,
	coFounderAmount,
	personalFounderAmount,
	cloudAmount
	FROM
		(SELECT
			target.targetAmount AS targetAmount,
			total.totalAmount AS totalAmount,
			( total.totalAmount / target.targetAmount )* 100 AS completionRate,
			target.targetAmount - total.totalAmount AS difference,
			IF(#{endTime} > CURDATE(),DATEDIFF(#{endTime}, CURDATE()) + 1,1) AS remainingDays,
			IF(#{startTime}  > CURDATE(), 0,IF(#{endTime} > CURDATE(), DATEDIFF(CURDATE(),#{startTime} ) + 1, DATEDIFF(#{endTime},#{startTime}) +1)) AS passedDays,
			headOfficeTotal.headOfficeAmount AS headOfficeAmount,
			coFounderTotal.coFounderAmount AS coFounderAmount,
			personalFounderTotal.personalFounderAmount  AS personalFounderAmount,
			IFNULL(cloudAmount.cloudAmount,0)  as cloudAmount
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					SUM(IF( flow_type = 'out', 0-flow_amount, flow_amount )) AS totalAmount 
				FROM
					dms_cwallet.total_amount_view 
				WHERE
					sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
					AND custom_level = 'branch_office' 
					AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime}  AND #{endTime}
					AND custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
			) total,
			(
				SELECT

				FROM

				WHERE
				sale_mode = 'bcompany'
				AND month BETWEEN #{startTime}  AND #{endTime} 
				AND custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore )
			) target,
			(
				SELECT

				FROM
					dms_cwallet.total_amount_view 
				WHERE
					sale_mode = 'bcompany'

					AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime}  AND #{endTime}
					AND custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
			) headOfficeTotal,
			(
				SELECT
					SUM(IF( flow_type = 'out', 0-flow_amount, flow_amount )) AS coFounderAmount 
				FROM
					dms_cwallet.total_amount_view 
				WHERE
					sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
					AND custom_level = 'co_founder' 
					AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime}  AND #{endTime}
					AND custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
			) coFounderTotal,
			(
				SELECT
					SUM(IF( flow_type = 'out', 0-flow_amount, flow_amount )) AS personalFounderAmount 
				FROM
					dms_cwallet.total_amount_view 
				WHERE
					sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
					AND custom_level = 'personal_founder' 
					AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime}  AND #{endTime}
					AND custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
			) personalFounderTotal,
			(SELECT
					SUM(IF( flow_type = 'out', 0-flow_amount, flow_amount )) AS cloudAmount 
				FROM
					dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow a
					join dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow_related b on a.flow_no = b.flow_no
					join dms_distributor.view_dd_cust_customer_cloud c on a.custom_code = c.cust_code
				WHERE
					a.sale_mode = 'cloud' and a.sale_channel = 'cloud' 
					and a.project_category in (
					'strategy_recharge', 
					'pre_charge', 
					'strategy_transform', 
					'custom_transform',

					)	
					AND `b`.`custom_wallet` = 'ACC_CASH_BAL' and a.business_flow = 'Y' and b.account_splitting = 'N' and b.custom_account_type_name = '2025面膜新势力'
					AND a.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
				) cloudAmount
			)

        WHEN s.totalAmount > 0 AND totalAmount <= 10000 THEN '小于1万'
        WHEN s.totalAmount > 10000 AND totalAmount <= 30000 THEN '1万到3万之间'
        WHEN s.totalAmount > 30000 AND totalAmount <= 50000 THEN '3万到5万之间'
        WHEN s.totalAmount > 50000 AND totalAmount <= 80000 THEN '5万到8万之间'
        ELSE '8万以上'
    END AS amountRange,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.customCode) AS peopleCount,
    SUM(s.totalAmount) AS totalAmountSum 
FROM
        (SELECT 
                        a.totalAmount,
                        a.customName,
                        a.customCode,
                        (a.totalAmount/b.totalAmountSum)*100 AS ratio
        FROM
                        (SELECT 
                                        custom_code AS customCode,
                                        custom_name AS customName,
                                        SUM(last_after_flow_amount) AS totalAmount
                        FROM merged_data
                        WHERE last_after_flow_amount IS NOT NULL
                        GROUP BY custom_code
                        ORDER BY totalAmount DESC) a,
                        (SELECT 
                                        SUM(last_after_flow_amount) AS totalAmountSum
                        FROM merged_data) b ORDER BY a.totalAmount desc) s GROUP BY amountRange
ORDER BY FIELD(amountRange, '0', '小于1万', '1万到3万之间', '3万到5万之间', '5万到8万之间', '8万以上')

-- 获取在指定时间范围内每个 id 对应的最后一条记录
WITH last_in_time_range AS (
    SELECT
        a.id,
        b.after_flow_amount,
        b.flow_no,
				a.custom_wallet,
				a.custom_subject_code,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.id ORDER BY b.create_time DESC, b.id DESC) AS rn
    FROM
        (
        SELECT
            id,
            custom_wallet,
						custom_subject_code 
        FROM
            dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_bcompany 
        WHERE
            del_flag = 'N' 
            AND custom_wallet = 'ACC_CASH_BAL'
            AND custom_company_partner_type = #{companyPartnerType}  
        ) a
    LEFT JOIN dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow b ON a.id = b.custom_wallet_id 
    WHERE
				b.del_flag = 'N'
        AND b.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}   
),
-- 获取在时间范围之前每个 id 对应的最后一条记录
last_before_time_range AS (
    SELECT
        a.id,
        b.after_flow_amount,
        b.flow_no,
				a.custom_wallet,
				a.custom_subject_code,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.id ORDER BY b.create_time DESC, b.id DESC) AS rn
    FROM
        (
        SELECT
            id,
            custom_wallet,
						custom_subject_code 
        FROM
            dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_bcompany 
        WHERE
            del_flag = 'N' 
            AND custom_wallet = 'ACC_CASH_BAL'
            AND custom_company_partner_type = #{companyPartnerType} 
        ) a
    LEFT JOIN dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow b ON a.id = b.custom_wallet_id 
    WHERE
				b.del_flag = 'N'
        AND b.create_time < #{startTime}
),
custom_info_by_distributor AS (
	SELECT
	cc.cust_name,
	cs.subject,
	cs.credit_card
FROM
	dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel r
	INNER JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_channel_subject_rel sr ON r.subject_id = sr.subject_id
	INNER JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject cs ON r.cust_subject_code = cs.credit_card
	INNER JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer cc ON r.cust_code = cc.cust_code
	AND sr.sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
	AND sr.sale_channel = 'cloud' 
WHERE
	r.company_partner_type = #{companyPartnerType} 
	AND sr.sign_status = 'signed'
	AND r.cust_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore)
	AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel cr WHERE r.subject_id = cr.parent_id)
),
custom_total_amount AS (
	SELECT 
	amount,
	subject_code
FROM
	(SELECT
		SUM( CASE WHEN flow_type = 'out' THEN - flow_amount ELSE flow_amount END ) AS amount,
		custom_subject_code AS subject_code
	 FROM
		dms_cwallet.total_amount_view

	 AND custom_level = #{companyPartnerType} 
	 and project_category not in ('old_and_new_cash_balance_merge','old_and_new_no_cash_balance_merge','custom_transform','strategy_transform','strategy_transform_change','org_transfer_a_a','history_after_sales_transfer','dms_initial_data','brand_merger_single_to_full','three_in_one_transfer','whole_brand_transfer')
	 AND custom_wallet = 'ACC_CASH_BAL'
	 AND custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
	 AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}  
   GROUP BY custom_subject_code)
),
extract_amount_info AS (
	SELECT
        a.customer_subject_code as custom_subject_code,
        TRUNCATE((a.amount - ifnull(b.afterSaleAmount,0)),2)  as extract_amount
FROM
        (
                (
                SELECT
                        customer_subject_code,
                        ifnull(sum(case when o.customer_wallet_code = 'ACC_CASH_BAL'  then (o.goods_count - o.cancelled_count) * transaction_price end ) ,0 ) as amount 
                FROM
                        dms_trading.view_bcompany_order_info o

                WHERE

                        AND o.order_status IN ( 'PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING','COMPLETED') 
                        AND o.warehouse_code = 'SH01' 
												AND o.payment_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}  
                        AND o.customer_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
                GROUP BY
                        o.customer_subject_code 
                ) a left join 
        ( SELECT
                customer_subject_code,
                ifnull(sum(CASE WHEN customer_wallet_code = 'ACC_CASH_BAL' then refund_amount end ),0) as afterSaleAmount
                FROM
                        dms_trading.view_bcompany_aftersale_info 
                WHERE
                        after_sale_status = 'COMPLETED' 
                        AND company_partner_type = #{companyPartnerType} 
												AND warehouse_checker_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}  
                GROUP BY
                        customer_subject_code 
                ) b on a.customer_subject_code = b.customer_subject_code
        ) where amount > 0
),
total_first_order_info AS (
	 SELECT
                o.customer_subject_code as  custom_subject_code,
                COUNT( DISTINCT o.order_no ) AS total_first_order

                AND o.company_partner_type = #{companyPartnerType}

                AND o.warehouse_code = 'SH01'

                AND o.order_status IN ( 'PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING', 'COMPLETED' )
								AND payment_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}   
                AND o.customer_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
                GROUP BY o.customer_subject_code 
)
-- 合并两部分数据，确保每个 id 只有一条记录
SELECT

	FROM
			(SELECT

					custom_wallet,

		LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_contract_subject_rel ppsr ON psr.parent_id = ppsr.subject_id
		LEFT JOIN dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer ppc ON ppsr.cust_code = ppc.cust_code

SELECT 
a.totalAmount - c.afterSaleAmount as cumulativePickUp, -- 累计提货
round(((a.totalAmount - c.afterSaleAmount) / d.returnAmount),2)  as pickUpProportion, -- 提货占比
d.returnAmount - a.totalAmount + c.afterSaleAmount remainingPickUpAmount, -- 剩余可提货金额
round(((d.returnAmount - a.totalAmount + c.afterSaleAmount) / d.returnAmount),2) remainingPickUpAmountProportion, -- 剩余可提货金额占比
round(((a.totalAmount - c.afterSaleAmount)/ dateDiff(DATE(IF(#{endTime} <= NOW(),#{endTime},NOW()) ), DATE(#{startTime}))),2) dayPickUp, -- 日均提货
round(((d.returnAmount - a.totalAmount + c.afterSaleAmount) / ((a.totalAmount - c.afterSaleAmount)/ dateDiff(DATE(IF(#{endTime} <= NOW(),#{endTime},NOW()) ), DATE(#{startTime})))),2) as ramainingReturnDay, -- 剩余回款消耗天数
DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (CEILING((d.returnAmount - a.totalAmount + c.afterSaleAmount) / ((a.totalAmount - c.afterSaleAmount)/ dateDiff(DATE(IF(#{endTime} <= NOW(),#{endTime},NOW()) ), DATE(#{startTime}))))) DAY), '%Y年%m月%d日') AS futureDate -- 消耗完日期
from (
(SELECT
	
	IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN o.sale_mode = 'bcompany' AND od.customer_wallet_code IN ( 'ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_SPECIAL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE' ) THEN od.transaction_subtotal
	WHEN o.sale_mode = 'cloud' AND od.customer_wallet_code IN ( 'ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_CASH_SPL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE' ) THEN od.transaction_subtotal
	 ELSE 0 END ),0 ) AS totalAmount ,
	IFNULL( SUM( CASE WHEN o.sale_mode = 'bcompany' AND od.customer_wallet_code IN ( 'ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_SPECIAL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE' ) and (od.goods_count - od.cancelled_count -od.real_deliver_count) > 0   THEN (od.goods_count - od.cancelled_count -od.real_deliver_count) * od.transaction_price 
	WHEN o.sale_mode = 'cloud' AND od.customer_wallet_code IN ( 'ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_CASH_SPL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE' ) and (od.goods_count - od.cancelled_count -od.real_deliver_count) > 0   THEN (od.goods_count - od.cancelled_count -od.real_deliver_count) * od.transaction_price 
	ELSE 0 END ),0 ) AS pendingAmount 
FROM
	dms_trading.dt_order o
	INNER JOIN dms_trading.dt_order_detail od ON o.order_no = od.order_no 
WHERE
	o.del_flag = 'N' 
	AND o.sale_channel = 'cloud' AND (
	(o.sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
	AND o.transfer_flag = 'N' AND o.supplier_id NOT IN (1,2,4) 
	AND o.order_type != 'SUBSTITUTE_DELIVERY_ORDER' 
	AND o.warehouse_code = 'SH01') 
	OR (o.sale_mode = 'cloud' 
	AND o.transfer_flag = 'N' AND o.customer_code IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.view_dd_cust_customer_cloud )))

	AND o.payment_status != 'UNPAID' 
	AND o.order_status IN ( 'PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING', 'COMPLETED' ) 
	AND o.order_time >= #{startTime} 
	AND o.order_time <= #{endTime}
	AND o.customer_code NOT IN (
	SELECT
		cust_code 
FROM
	dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore) ) a 
	cross join (
SELECT
	ifnull(sum(b.refund_amount), 0) as afterSaleAmount

FROM
	dt_after_sale a
	INNER JOIN dt_after_sale_detail b ON a.after_sale_no = b.after_sale_no
	INNER JOIN dt_order_detail od ON b.order_details_no = od.order_details_no 
WHERE
	a.del_flag = 'N' 
	AND b.del_flag = 'N' 
	AND od.del_flag = 'N'
	AND a.sale_channel = 'cloud'
	AND (( a.sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
	and a.warehouse_code = 'SH01'
	and a.company_partner_type = 'branch_office')
	OR ( a.sale_mode = 'cloud' AND a.order_source != 'CLOUD_DELIVERY_TRANSFER' AND a.order_no != a.order_transfer_main_no AND a.customer_code IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.view_dd_cust_customer_cloud )))
	
	AND a.after_sale_type = 'RETURN'
	and a.after_sale_status = 'COMPLETED'
	and od.customer_wallet_code in ('ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_SPECIAL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE')
	and after_sale_creater_time >= #{startTime}
	and after_sale_creater_time <= #{endTime}
	) c 
	cross join (
	SELECT
	his.returnAmountHis + cur.returnAmountCur + IFNULL(cloud.cloudAmount,0) AS returnAmount 
FROM
	(
	SELECT
		SUM( CASE WHEN a.flow_type = 'out' THEN - a.flow_amount ELSE flow_amount END ) AS returnAmountHis 
	FROM
		dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow a,
		dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow_related b 
	WHERE
		a.flow_no = b.flow_no 
		AND a.sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
		AND b.custom_level = 'branch_office' 
		AND b.custom_wallet IN ( 'ACC_CASH_BAL', 'ACC_SPECIAL', 'ACC_CASH_POSTAGE' ) 
		AND a.project_category NOT IN ( 'old_and_new_cash_balance_merge', 'old_and_new_no_cash_balance_merge', 'custom_transform', 'strategy_transform', 'strategy_transform_change', 'org_transfer_a_a', 'history_after_sales_transfer', 'dms_initial_data', 'brand_merger_single_to_full', 'three_in_one_transfer', 'whole_brand_transfer' ) 
		AND a.custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
		AND a.create_time < #{startTime}
		
	) his,
	(
	SELECT
		SUM( CASE WHEN flow_type = 'out' THEN - flow_amount ELSE flow_amount END ) AS returnAmountCur 
	FROM
		dms_cwallet.total_amount_view 
	WHERE
		sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
		AND custom_level = 'branch_office' 
		AND project_category NOT IN ( 'old_and_new_cash_balance_merge', 'old_and_new_no_cash_balance_merge', 'custom_transform', 'strategy_transform', 'strategy_transform_change', 'org_transfer_a_a', 'history_after_sales_transfer', 'dms_initial_data', 'brand_merger_single_to_full', 'three_in_one_transfer', 'whole_brand_transfer' ) 
		AND custom_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
		AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
		
	) cur,
	(
	SELECT
		SUM(
		IF
		( flow_type = 'out', 0-flow_amount, flow_amount )) AS cloudAmount 
	FROM
		dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow a
		JOIN dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow_related b ON a.flow_no = b.flow_no
		JOIN dms_distributor.view_dd_cust_customer_cloud c ON a.custom_code = c.cust_code 
	WHERE

        GROUP BY
            custom_account_type,
            custom_subject_code 
    ) a 
    WHERE
        a.sums > 0 
    GROUP BY

    UNION ALL
    
    -- 第二部分查询
    SELECT 
        custom_account_type_name,
        COUNT(custom_code) AS number 
    FROM (
        SELECT
            custom_account_type_name,
            custom_code,
            SUM(CASE WHEN flow_type = 'out' THEN -flow_amount ELSE flow_amount END) sums 
        FROM
            dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow f

        a.sums > 0

        AND custom_code NOT IN (SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore) 
    GROUP BY
        custom_account_type_name 
    HAVING 
        sums > 0
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 第二部分查询：云端业务数据
    SELECT
        custom_account_type_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN flow_type = 'out' THEN -flow_amount ELSE flow_amount END) AS sums 
    FROM
        dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow f 
        JOIN dms_cwallet.dcw_custom_wallet_flow_related r ON f.flow_no = r.flow_no
        JOIN dms_distributor.view_dd_cust_customer_info i ON f.custom_code = i.cust_code
    WHERE
        f.sale_mode = 'cloud' 
        AND f.sale_channel = 'cloud'
        AND f.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
        AND r.custom_account_type_name = '2025面膜新势力'
    GROUP BY
        custom_account_type_name 
    HAVING 
        sums > 0
),
latest_flow_amounts AS (
    -- 获取每个钱包最新余额
    SELECT
        a.custom_wallet_id,
        a.after_flow_amount,
        b.custom_account_type,
        b.custom_account_type_name,
        a.create_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.custom_wallet_id ORDER BY a.create_time DESC) AS rn
    FROM
        dcw_custom_wallet_flow a
        JOIN dcw_custom_wallet_flow_related b ON a.flow_no = b.flow_no
				LEFT JOIN dcw_custom_meta c on a.custom_code = c.dc_custom_id and c.sale_channel = 'cloud'
				LEFT JOIN dcw_custom_meta cc on c.supplier_code = cc.dc_custom_id and cc.sale_channel = 'cloud'

        AND b.custom_account_type_name IN (SELECT custom_account_type_name FROM combined_data)
),
wallet_summary AS (
    SELECT
        custom_account_type_name,
        SUM(after_flow_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM
        latest_flow_amounts
    WHERE
        rn = 1
    GROUP BY
        custom_account_type_name
)

SELECT 
    A.custom_account_type_name,
    A.sums,
    ROUND((A.sums / (SELECT SUM(sums) FROM combined_data)) * 100, 2) AS ratio,
    B.total_amount as balance
FROM 
    combined_data A
    JOIN wallet_summary B ON A.custom_account_type_name = B.custom_account_type_name
ORDER BY 
    A.sums DESC

sql_text:
SELECT  
    t.goodsName,  
    IFNULL(a.goodsCount, 0) AS goodsCount,  
    IFNULL(b.deliverCount, 0) AS deliverCount,  
    IFNULL(c.realWaitingCount, 0) AS realWaitingCount  
FROM  
    (  
        SELECT  
            od.goods_code,  
            IFNULL(goods.sku_short_name, goods.sku_name) AS goodsName  
        FROM  
            dms_trading.dt_order o  
            INNER JOIN dms_trading.dt_order_detail od ON o.order_no = od.order_no  
            INNER JOIN dms_goods.dg_goods_goods goods ON od.goods_code = goods.sku_code  
        WHERE  
            o.del_flag = 'N'   
            AND od.del_flag = 'N'
						AND o.sale_channel = 'cloud'
            AND ((o.sale_mode = 'bcompany'   
            AND o.transfer_flag = 'Y'   
            AND o.order_type != 'SUBSTITUTE_DELIVERY_ORDER')
						OR ( o.sale_mode = 'cloud' AND o.transfer_flag = 'N' AND o.customer_code IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.view_dd_cust_customer_cloud) AND od.goods_code IN ('SCLMWS2023041703', 'SCLMWS2023053001', 'SCLMWS2020092801'))) 
            AND o.payment_status != 'UNPAID'   
            AND o.order_status IN ('PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING', 'COMPLETED')   
            AND o.warehouse_code = 'SH01'   
            AND o.logistics_flag = 'Y'   
            AND o.customer_code NOT IN (SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore)  
        GROUP BY  
            od.goods_code   
    ) t  
    LEFT JOIN   
    (  
        SELECT  
            od.goods_code,  
            SUM(od.goods_count) AS goodsCount  
        FROM  
            dms_trading.dt_order o  
            INNER JOIN dms_trading.dt_order_detail od ON o.order_no = od.order_no  
        WHERE  
            o.del_flag = 'N'   
            AND od.del_flag = 'N'   
            	AND o.sale_channel = 'cloud'
            AND ((o.sale_mode = 'bcompany'   
            AND o.transfer_flag = 'Y'   
            AND o.order_type != 'SUBSTITUTE_DELIVERY_ORDER')
						OR ( o.sale_mode = 'cloud' AND o.transfer_flag = 'N' AND o.customer_code IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.view_dd_cust_customer_cloud) AND od.goods_code IN ('SCLMWS2023041703', 'SCLMWS2023053001', 'SCLMWS2020092801')))   
            AND o.payment_status != 'UNPAID'   
            AND o.order_status IN ('PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING', 'COMPLETED')   
            AND o.warehouse_code = 'SH01'   
            AND o.logistics_flag = 'Y'   
            AND o.order_time >= #{startTime} 
            AND o.order_time <= #{endTime}  
            AND o.customer_code NOT IN (SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore)  
        GROUP BY  
            od.goods_code   
    ) a ON t.goods_code = a.goods_code  
    LEFT JOIN (  
        SELECT  
            dd.goods_code,  
            SUM(dd.deliver_count) AS deliverCount  
        FROM  
            dt_deliver d  
            INNER JOIN dt_deliver_detail dd ON d.deliver_no = dd.deliver_no   
        WHERE  
            d.del_flag = 'N'   
            AND (d.sale_mode = 'bcompany'  OR (d.sale_mode = 'cloud' AND d.customer_code IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.view_dd_cust_customer_cloud) AND dd.goods_code IN ('SCLMWS2023041703', 'SCLMWS2023053001', 'SCLMWS2020092801')) )
            AND d.warehouse_code = 'SH01'   
            AND d.push_wms_flag = 'Y'   
            AND d.deliver_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED')   
            AND d.deliver_time >= #{startTime} 
            AND d.deliver_time <= #{endTime}  
            AND d.customer_code NOT IN (SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore)  
        GROUP BY  
            dd.goods_code   
    ) b ON t.goods_code = b.goods_code   
    LEFT JOIN (  
        SELECT  
            od.goods_code,  
            SUM(od.goods_count - od.cancelled_count - od.real_deliver_count) AS realWaitingCount   
        FROM  
            dms_trading.dt_order o  
            INNER JOIN dms_trading.dt_order_detail od ON o.order_no = od.order_no  
            INNER JOIN dms_goods.dg_goods_goods goods ON od.goods_code = goods.sku_code  
        WHERE  
            o.del_flag = 'N'   
            AND od.del_flag = 'N' 
					AND o.sale_channel = 'cloud'		
            AND ((o.sale_mode = 'bcompany'   
            AND o.transfer_flag = 'Y'   
            AND o.order_type = 'NORMAL_ORDER' )
					OR ( o.sale_mode = 'cloud' AND o.transfer_flag = 'N' AND o.customer_code IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.view_dd_cust_customer_cloud) AND od.goods_code IN ('SCLMWS2023041703', 'SCLMWS2023053001', 'SCLMWS2020092801'))) 		
            AND o.payment_status != 'UNPAID'   
            AND o.order_status IN ('PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING', 'COMPLETED')   
						AND o.order_time <= #{endTime}  
            AND o.warehouse_code = 'SH01'   
            AND o.logistics_flag = 'Y'   
            AND o.customer_code NOT IN (SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore)  
        GROUP BY  
            od.goods_code   
    ) c ON t.goods_code = c.goods_code  
WHERE  
    IFNULL(a.goodsCount, 0) > 0 OR   
    IFNULL(b.deliverCount, 0) > 0 OR   
    IFNULL(c.realWaitingCount, 0) > 0  
ORDER BY  
    a.goodsCount DESC

name: 每日数据-发货数据
sql_text:
SELECT
	a.todayPushedDeliverCount,
	b.historyUnDeliverCount,
	a.todayPushedDeliverCount + b.historyUnDeliverCount  as todayNeedDeliverCount,
	c.*
FROM
	(
	SELECT
		SUM( CASE WHEN generate_time >= #{startTime} AND generate_time <= #{endTime} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS todayPushedDeliverCount,
		SUM( CASE WHEN generate_time >= #{startTime} AND generate_time <= #{endTime} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) + SUM( CASE WHEN generate_time <= #{startTime} and deliver_time is null THEN 1 ELSE 0 END )  AS todayNeedDeliverCount 
	FROM
		dms_trading.dt_deliver 
	WHERE
		del_flag = 'N' 
		AND sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
		AND warehouse_code = 'SH01' 
		AND push_wms_flag = 'Y' 
		and customer_code not in (SELECT cust_code from dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore)
		AND deliver_status not IN ( 'CANCELLED' ) 
	) AS a
	
	cross join 
	(
	SELECT
		SUM( CASE WHEN deliver_time is null THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) + SUM( CASE WHEN deliver_time >= #{startTime} AND deliver_time <= #{endTime}  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END )   AS historyUnDeliverCount
	FROM
		dms_trading.dt_deliver 
	WHERE
		del_flag = 'N' 
		AND sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
		AND warehouse_code = 'SH01' 
		AND push_wms_flag = 'Y' 
		and generate_time <= #{startTime}
		AND deliver_status not IN ( 'CANCELLED' ) 
	and customer_code not in (SELECT cust_code from dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore) 
	) as  b
	
	CROSS JOIN (
	SELECT
		count( 1 ) AS todayDeliverCount,
		SUM( CASE WHEN full_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS deliverFullCount,
		SUM( CASE WHEN full_flag = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS deliverUnfullCount 
	FROM
		dms_trading.dt_deliver 
	WHERE
		del_flag = 'N' 
		AND sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
		AND warehouse_code = 'SH01' 
		AND push_wms_flag = 'Y' 
		AND deliver_status IN ( 'SENDED', 'COMPLETED' ) 
		AND deliver_time >= #{startTime} 
	AND deliver_time <= #{endTime} 
	and customer_code not in (SELECT cust_code from dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore )
	) AS c

sql_text:
SELECT
	IF(IFNULL(dgg.sku_short_name, dgg.sku_name) = '', dgg.sku_name, dgg.sku_short_name)  AS skuName,
	dgg.sku_code AS skuCode,

	dgg.shelf_status,
	dgg.shelf_date,
	dgws.third_good_stock,
	datediff(DATE(now()), DATE(dgws.third_good_time)) + 1 as outOfStockDays,
	DATE(dgg.arrival_time) as arrivalTime,
	temp.sumNum as waitSend
FROM
	dms_goods.dg_goods_wh_sku dgws
inner join dms_goods.dg_goods_goods dgg on
	dgws.sku_id = dgg.id
left JOIN (
			SELECT  
            od.goods_code,  
            SUM(od.goods_count - od.cancelled_count - od.real_deliver_count) AS sumNum   
        FROM  
            dms_trading.dt_order o  
            INNER JOIN dms_trading.dt_order_detail od ON o.order_no = od.order_no  
            INNER JOIN dms_goods.dg_goods_goods goods ON od.goods_code = goods.sku_code  
        WHERE  
            o.del_flag = 'N'   
            AND od.del_flag = 'N'   
            AND o.sale_mode = 'bcompany'   
            AND o.transfer_flag = 'Y'   
            AND o.order_type != 'SUBSTITUTE_DELIVERY_ORDER'   
            AND o.payment_status != 'UNPAID'

WHERE

	and dgg.sale_mode = 'bcompany'
	and dgg.sku_flag = 'S'

	and (dgg.shelf_status = 'Y' or (dgg.shelf_status = 'N' and DATEDIFF(DATE(NOW()), DATE(dgg.shelf_date)) + 1 <= 30))
	having outOfStockDays < 180
order by
	outOfStockDays DESC
remarks: 缺货天数：当前时间-仓库库存变为0的时间；/n到货时间：指DMS后台配置的缺货到货时间；/n待发量：指截止到当天23：59：59系统内仍需要发货的商品数量;

name: 补货计划
sql_text:
SELECT * FROM 						
	(SELECT
	sku_name as skuName,
	third_good_stock as thirdGoodStock,
	market_days as marketDays,
	sale_count as saleCount,
	daily_sale as dailySale,
	sale_days as saleDays,
	DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (15-sale_days) DAY) AS lastReplenishmentTime
FROM
	(
	SELECT
		*,
		ceil(dgws.third_good_stock / if(daily_sale = 0,
		1,
		daily_sale)) AS sale_days
	FROM
		(
		SELECT
			*,
			CASE
				WHEN market_days >= 90 THEN CEIL(sale_count / 90)
				ELSE CEIL(sale_count / market_days)
			END AS daily_sale
		from
			(
			SELECT
				dgg.id AS id,
				IFNULL(dgg.sku_short_name, dgg.sku_name) AS sku_name,
				dgws.third_good_stock AS third_good_stock,
				dateDiff(CURDATE(),
 DATE(dgg.sale_time2market)) AS market_days
 ,
				ifNull(temp.saleCount,
 0) AS sale_count
			FROM
				dms_goods.dg_goods_wh_sku AS dgws
			INNER JOIN dms_goods.dg_goods_goods AS dgg ON
				dgws.sku_id = dgg.id
			LEFT JOIN
(
				SELECT
					od.goods_code,
					sum(od.goods_count - od.cancelled_count) AS saleCount
				FROM
					dms_trading.dt_order AS o
				INNER JOIN dms_trading.dt_order_detail AS od ON
					o.order_no = od.order_no
				WHERE
					(o.del_flag = 'N')
						AND (o.sale_mode = 'bcompany')
							AND (o.transfer_flag = 'Y')
								AND (o.order_type != 'SUBSTITUTE_DELIVERY_ORDER')
									AND (o.payment_status != 'UNPAID')
										AND (o.order_status IN ('PENDING_SEND',
 'SENDING',
 'COMPLETED'))
											AND (o.order_time >= CONCAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY), ' 00:00:00'))
												AND (o.order_time < CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 00:00:00'))
											GROUP BY
												od.goods_code
) AS temp ON
				temp.goods_code = dgg.sku_code
			WHERE
				(dgws.warehouse_code = 'SH01')
				AND (dgg.sale_mode = 'bcompany')
				AND (dgg.sku_flag = 'S')
-- 				AND (dgg.shelf_status = 'Y') 注释下架条件 因为缺货会直接下架
				)))) as t
				WHERE dateDiff(CURDATE(), DATE(t.lastReplenishmentTime)) BETWEEN -60 AND 60
				
ORDER BY
	t.lastReplenishmentTime ASC
remarks: 库存量：指截止到当前时间仓库内的可发货的库存数量;/n可卖天数：可发货库存÷日均销售（取近半年的销售÷天数）;/n补货时间：可售卖时间（根据可售卖天数计算）-15天   列表只展示距离当前时间大于等于60天和小于等于60天的数据；

	LEFT JOIN centerx.sys_dict_item di ON mr.company_partner_type = di.`value`  AND di.`type` = 'company_partner_type'

	AND o.warehouse_code = 'SH01'

name: 下单时间峰值-每日

SELECT  
    CASE DAYOFWEEK(order_time)  
        WHEN 1 THEN '周日'  
        WHEN 2 THEN '周一'  
        WHEN 3 THEN '周二'  
        WHEN 4 THEN '周三'  
        WHEN 5 THEN '周四'  
        WHEN 6 THEN '周五'  
        WHEN 7 THEN '周六'  
    END AS weekDay, 
    COUNT(1) AS orderCount  
FROM  
    dms_trading.dt_order   
WHERE  
    del_flag = 'N'   
    AND sale_mode = 'bcompany'   
    AND company_partner_type = 'branch_office'  
    AND order_type != 'SUBSTITUTE_DELIVERY_ORDER'   
    AND payment_status != 'UNPAID'  
		AND warehouse_code = 'SH01'
    AND order_status IN ('PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING', 'COMPLETED')   
    AND order_time >= #{startTime}  
    AND order_time <= #{endTime}  
    AND customer_code NOT IN (SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore)  
GROUP BY weekDay  
ORDER BY FIELD(weekDay, '周一', '周二', '周三', '周四', '周五', '周六', '周日')

			AND after_sale_creater_time <= #{endTime}

			AND order_time >= #{startTime}
			AND order_time <= #{endTime}
			AND customer_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
			GROUP BY order_no
		) a ON o.transfer_main_no = a.transfer_main_no 
		AND o.company_partner_type = 'branch_office'
	WHERE
		 o.order_status IN ( 'PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING', 'COMPLETED' ) 
		AND o.customer_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
GROUP BY
	a.company_partner_type order by a.company_partner_type
remarks: 指时间范围内各个身份下单的数量，下单金额（取分公司身份支付的金额），下单的人数;

name: 待发订单商品数量
sql_text:
SELECT
