name: 订单平均发货时长
sql_text:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN DATEDIFF(last_deliver_time, order_time) <= 3 THEN '3日内发货'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(last_deliver_time, order_time) BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN '4-7日内发货'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(last_deliver_time, order_time) BETWEEN 8 AND 15 THEN '8-15天内发货'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(last_deliver_time, order_time) BETWEEN 16 AND 30 THEN '16-30天内发货'
        ELSE '30天以上'
    END AS delivery_time_range,
    COUNT(DISTINCT deliver_info.order_no) AS order_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        o.order_no,
				o.order_time,
        MAX(d.deliver_time) AS last_deliver_time
    FROM 
        dt_order o
    inner JOIN 
        dt_deliver d ON o.transfer_main_no = d.order_transfer_main_no
    WHERE 
        o.del_flag = 'N' 
        AND o.sale_mode = 'bcompany' 
        AND o.company_partner_type = 'branch_office'
        AND o.order_type = 'NORMAL_ORDER' 
        AND o.payment_status != 'UNPAID' 
				and o.warehouse_code = 'SH01'
        AND o.order_status IN ('SENDING', 'COMPLETED') 
        AND o.deliver_status = 'ALL_SENDED'
				and d.deliver_status in ('SENDED','COMPLETED')
        AND o.order_time >= #{startTime}
        AND o.order_time <= #{endTime}
    GROUP BY 
        o.order_no
) AS deliver_info
GROUP BY 
    delivery_time_range
ORDER BY 
    FIELD(delivery_time_range,'3日内发货','4-7日内发货','8-15天内发货','16-30天内发货','30天以上');
remarks: 指时间范围内下的订单中，从下单到该订单全部发货系统处理的平均时长；

name: 订单数据
sql_text:
SELECT 
a.totalOrders ,
a.totalAmount - c.afterSaleAmount as totalAmount,
b.pendingOrder,
a.pendingAmount 
from (
(
		SELECT
			COUNT( DISTINCT order_no ) AS totalOrders ,
			IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN financial_wallet_name = '现金' THEN transaction_subtotal ELSE 0 END ),0 ) AS totalAmount ,
			IFNULL( SUM( CASE WHEN financial_wallet_name = '现金' and real_waiting_count > 0   THEN real_waiting_count * transaction_price ELSE 0 END ),0 ) AS pendingAmount 
		FROM
			view_bcompany_order_info 
		WHERE
			company_partner_type = 'branch_office' 
			AND order_status IN ( 'PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING', 'COMPLETED' ) 
			AND order_time >= #{startTime} 
			AND order_time <= #{endTime} 
			AND customer_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore )
	) a 
CROSS join 
(
SELECT
	COUNT( DISTINCT order_no ) AS pendingOrder
FROM
	dms_trading.view_bcompany_order_info 
WHERE
	 company_partner_type = 'branch_office'
	AND order_status IN ( 'PENDING_SEND' ,'SENDING') 
	and deliver_status in ('PENDING_SEND','PART_SENDED')
	AND order_time >= #{startTime}
	AND order_time <= #{endTime}
	AND customer_code NOT IN (SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore) ) b 
	cross join (
	SELECT IFNULL(sum(refund_amount),0) as afterSaleAmount 
	from view_bcompany_aftersale_info 
	where 
	company_partner_type = 'branch_office'
	and after_sale_status = 'COMPLETED'
	and after_sale_creater_time >= #{startTime}
	and after_sale_creater_time <= #{endTime}
	and financial_wallet_name = '现金'
	AND customer_code NOT IN (SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore) 
	) c 
)
remarks: 订单数量：时间范围内共下单的订单数量;/n订单金额：时间范围内下单的订单中分公司身份使用现金钱包支付金额;/n待发货订单：时间范围内下单的订单中截止到当前时间仍未发货完成的订单；/n待发货金额：时间范围内未发货的订单中使用现金钱包支付的金额;

name: 订单来源占比
sql_text:
SELECT
CASE
	WHEN
		order_source = 'CUSTOMER_ORDER' THEN

			WHEN order_source = 'BCOMPANY_CUSTOMER_TRANSFER' THEN
			'C端转单'

			'客服导单' 
		END AS orderSource,
		count( DISTINCT order_no ) sourceCount,
		count( DISTINCT customer_code ) sourceCustomerCount,
		IFNULL(
			TRUNCATE ( SUM( CASE WHEN financial_wallet_name  = '现金'THEN transaction_subtotal ELSE 0 END ), 2 ),
			0 
		) AS sourceTotalAmount 
	FROM
		dms_trading.view_bcompany_order_info

		 company_partner_type = 'branch_office' 
		AND order_status IN ( 'PENDING_SEND', 'SENDING', 'COMPLETED' ) 
		AND order_source IN ( 'CUSTOMER_ORDER', 'BCOMPANY_CUSTOMER_TRANSFER', 'BCOMPANY_SYSTEM_IMPORT' ) 
		AND order_time >= #{startTime}
		AND order_time <= #{endTime}
		AND customer_code NOT IN ( SELECT cust_code FROM dms_distributor.dd_cust_customer_ignore ) 
GROUP BY order_source order by order_source
